purpose: the level and constraint phrases the query parser reads (src/query-intent.js, src/intents.js)

matching.text: the canonical query (trimmed, whitespace collapsed, lower-cased) after typo correction
matching.boundary: a phrase matches only where it is neither preceded nor followed by [a-z0-9]
matching.space: a space inside a phrase matches a run of one or more whitespace or '-' characters; every other character is literal

placeholders.N: level phrases: one digit 1-9; hours phrases: an integer 1-99 (\d{1,2})

matching.longest: leftmost-longest, non-overlapping: at each position the longest phrase of the pass wins, and a phrase inside a longer match is not read on its own
passes: pass A, parse step 4: every `constraints` phrase, matched and stripped from the lexical query before any code join
pass B, parse step 7: every `level` phrase and the GE phrases (eval/query-rules/ge-pillars.json), on the text left after steps 4-6
matching.shared: `no background` is in both `constraints.prereq` and `level.beginner`: pass A matches and strips it, and it sets the beginner intent as if pass B had read it
matching.strip: matched phrases are stripped from the lexical query only; the dense query stays raw for level and GE phrases, and is stripped for constraint phrases (src/intents.js INTENT_VARIANT)
matching.negation: pass B only: a level phrase with a negator among the two tokens before it (tokens as src/fts-query.js queryTokens splits them) sets no intent and stays in the query text

hoursBelow.notes: `light workload` and `low workload` set hoursBelow=10 ("light" = 10 h); the others set N

prereq.notes: `$selected` stands for the prereq semantics in force ("i" or "ii", src/intents.js INTENT_VARIANT); the query-suite harness substitutes it

levelN.alsoFromCodes: `XX N000` sets level N through code resolution step 3, not through this list

level.union: several level phrases (and an `XX N000` level) in one query: interpreted.level.min is the smallest min, max the largest max (null when any is null), source the sorted distinct kinds; α applies iff `beginner` is among them
level.interpreted: { min, max, source } with source a sorted array of 'beginner' | 'graduate' | 'level' | 'year'; null when no level intent
